subject.title: fix(secrets): keep startup alive when TTS SecretRefs are missing

question: Should active TTS provider API-key SecretRefs be optional at Gateway startup while gateway auth, model provider keys, plugin credentials, channel tokens, and other required SecretRefs remain fail-closed?
rationale: This is a real availability fix, but it deliberately changes the startup credential failure boundary for a provider capability, which automation should not approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve optional TTS degradation
options.body: Treat TTS provider API keys as optional startup credentials and merge after real Gateway startup proof confirms the intended degraded behavior.

options.title: Keep TTS fail-closed
options.body: Reject this direction and keep active TTS SecretRefs startup-fatal like other collected credentials.

options.title: Narrow the optional set
options.body: Ask for a smaller policy, such as only skipping inactive or unselected TTS provider refs, before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve optional TTS degradation
recommendation.body: Treat TTS provider API keys as optional startup credentials and merge after real Gateway startup proof confirms the intended degraded behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on SecretRef runtime semantics and prior TTS SecretRef snapshot behavior that joshavant worked on.
